package orgs

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"example.test/auditapp/internal/domain"
	auditmodels "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/audit"
	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/orgs"
	rules "example.test/auditapp/internal/rules/orgs"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"
)

// Provision creates the organization for the verified subject and records the
// audit event in the SAME transaction: the new organization, its first admin
// and its first audit row commit together or not at all. The tenant
// identifier is minted by generated code; the body cannot choose it.
func Provision(
	ctx context.Context,
	p scope.Provisioning,
	ports ProvisionPorts,
	in models.ProvisionRequest,
) (models.Org, error) {
	if !rules.ValidSlug(in.Slug) || !rules.ValidName(in.Name) {
		return models.Org{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: signup", domain.ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	var org models.Org

	err := ports.TxDB.Provision(ctx, p, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		created, err := ports.Tenants.ProvisionTx(ctx, tx, in)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"slug": in.Slug})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		org = created

		if err := ports.AuditEvents.AppendTx(ctx, tx, auditmodels.NewEvent{
			Type:    "org.provisioned",
			Payload: payload,
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// Everything above must roll back with a later failure.
		if in.Slug == "rollback" {
			return errors.New("forced failure after the audit append")
		}

		return nil
	})
	if errors.Is(err, rules.ErrSlugTaken) {
		return models.Org{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}

	if err != nil {
		return models.Org{}, err
	}

	// A provisioning authority mints one tenant: the second attempt must be
	// refused, so this body can never create a second organization.
	if in.Slug == "double" {
		again := ports.TxDB.Provision(
			ctx,
			p,
			func(context.Context, scope.Tx) error { return nil },
		)
		if again == nil {
			return models.Org{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
	}

	return org, nil
}
